payload.text: BEFORE OR WITH THE CUT: the CHANGELOG's harness bullet says 'A push that only moves the whiteboard runs nothing', which is true only for a push carrying nothing else -- 4 of 104 here. cc has said it will correct the sentence wherever the line lands. Whether Utilz keeps a paths-ignore line at all is hv's, reopened by vc's own correction: hv ruled yes on numbers vc has since measured in the wrong unit.
